title: Interfax: Russia restored access to Roblox after concluding the company had complied with local legal requirements; Russia had banned Roblox in December (Andrey Lemeshko/Bloomberg)
summary: Andrey Lemeshko / Bloomberg: Interfax: Russia restored access to Roblox after concluding the company had complied with local legal requirements; Russia had banned Roblox in December — Russia restored access to Roblox Corp.'s gaming platform after concluding the company had complied with local legal requirements, according to Interfax.
